Loop Events: the engineer's path

Today the title carries a ? with a two-sentence purpose, the toggle reads Episodes · 325 open | Fast conditions · 26 open, the filter row ends in "325 event(s)", the list has its own title "Open episodes" and the pager says "1–10 of 325 · page 1 of 33": the open count is on screen four times. The episode panel names the episode three times (EVT-2231 · Episode details, the tag ↗, the selected row), says who acknowledged twice (Review row and Activity), splits Condition and Availability into two rows, opens Shelve and Unshelve inline under the buttons and ends in a Technical details disclosure. Fast conditions is 300 rows in one scroll box with no search, "stale · last update 4 days ago" on every row and the condition repeated in its panel. Each view answers one question, which episodes need a response and what this one is, so the page gets no tabs: the header switches the view, the list finds the episode, the panel says what it is and holds the actions, and the foot names it once and leads to Investigation.

PageEpisodes | Fast conditionsHow to read·SearchOpen 325 ▾All severities ▾Triage ▾All windows ▾ (question 7)·Selected episodeFoot: PIC40102 · EVT-2231 · 24h … Investigation →

Header

Which list am I looking at, and how do I read its words?
  • Episodes | Fast conditions, top right (?view=)
  • How to read beside it: Review, Condition, Rows, Fast conditions in aligned columns
  • No ? on the title, no counts on the toggle

Find

Which episodes need a response?
  • Search first: loop, EVT number, family or diagnosis
  • State with its count (Open 325 …), severity, Triage / Newest; the loop chip from a link
  • Rows: tag, peak diagnosis, EVT · window; severity; review with the condition under it; opened
  • The shared pager, centred

Selected episode

What is it, and where does it stand?
  • Heading: the peak diagnosis, with its severity
  • Latest (only when it differs), Condition, Review, Shelf, Period
  • Peak evidence · qualified support · non-overlap windows
  • Record details, Historical ↗, Loop ↗

Respond

What do I do about it?
  • Note, Acknowledge, Shelve… / Update shelf…, Unshelve… (with a shelf), Save note
  • Shelve and Unshelve open dialogs; the reason under a disabled action
  • Activity & notes: who, when and why, newest first; Full history (dialog)

Foot

Which episode is this, and where next?
  • PIC40102 · EVT-2231 · 24h, once
  • Investigation →: the window the episode opened on

Fast conditions

What is held at a limit or frozen, before the next fused window?
  • Search, All / Open / Closed (question 2), pager
  • State, loop, condition over its gate, started, duration, close reason
  • Panel: gate, started, duration, last update, close reason; Workbench ↗, Window Inspector ↗; foot: loop and Loop Explorer →

What stays exactly

Two viewsEpisodes and Fast conditions, ?view= and ?condition= in the address
Links into the page?filter= ?severity= ?sort= ?loop= ?event=; an episode off the page is still read by id, with its note
The listServer paging, 10 a page, 30 s refresh; search, state, severity and order asked of the server
FiltersAll eight states with their counts; High / Medium / Low; Triage / Newest; the loop chip with ×
ColumnsLoop / peak diagnosis (tag, diagnosis, EVT · window), Severity, Review with Open / Open · Unobservable / Closed under it, Opened
Episode factsLatest, condition, review, shelf, period, peak evidence, qualified support, non-overlap windows, fault family, versions, support until
Safety textThe shelve and unshelve sentences on screen; the ? on Review for a closed, unacknowledged episode
ActionsAcknowledge (with the note), Shelve… / Update shelf…, Unshelve… only with a shelf, Save note, link an earlier loop note; the receipt of the last action beside them; refusals in place
Disabled actionsEach says why: Already acknowledged, A closed episode cannot be shelved, Needs the cpm.manage permission, Write the note first (hover)
Shelve rules1 hour, 8 hours, 24 hours, 7 days within the site limit (168 h on the lab), Until… in site time, a reason of 3+ characters, the expiry stated before sending, both kept on update
HistoryLatest three in Activity; every action and every linked note in Full history
StatesLoading, error with Retry, empty with Show all events or Current results in Performance
Fast conditionsEvery row, open first; stale after 10 min; close reason; the Explorer Summary at the gate; Window Inspector at 15m; the Workbench at 15m
SizesThree-line rows and type as today; 40 px filters and buttons; 32 px pager

For the owner to decide

  1. Counts off the toggle? The open count is in the state dropdown already (Open 325); the fast-condition count would be in its dropdown (Open 26). Recommended: yes. If the 26 open should show from Episodes, keep "· 26 open" on Fast conditions only.
  2. Search, state and pager on Fast conditions? Today 300 rows sit in one scroll box with no search; this adds a capability. Recommended: yes, as drawn (All 300 / Open 26 / Closed 274, pages of 10).
  3. "Investigation →" and "Loop Explorer →" in the feet? On this page "Review" is the acknowledgement column ("Review: Unacknowledged"), so "Review PIC40102 →" reads as if it records a review; it opens Investigation. Recommended: name the link after the page, as Calculations' "Investigation ↗". The other way round: keep "Review →" and rename the column.
  4. Shelve and Unshelve as dialogs? Today panels open under the buttons and push Activity down. Recommended: dialogs, as Record details on Calculations.
  5. Record details dialog in place of Technical details? Resolution (24h) goes, the row and the foot say it. Recommended: yes.
  6. A drawer below 1280 px? At 1000 px the panel sits under ten rows today. Recommended: a drawer a row opens, as Calculations and the Traverse guide's inspector rule.
  7. A window filter, All windows / 12h / 24h? Each finding is two rows, one per window kind (EVT-2231 · 24h and EVT-2230 · 12h for PIC40102), and every other CPA page has 12h / 24h. Adds a capability and a server parameter. Recommended: yes; drawn dashed.
  8. The unshelve sentence on an expired shelf. "…returns to the Unacknowledged queue" is not true for an expired shelf: open, the episode is in that queue already; closed, it never is. Recommended: "The episode stays unacknowledged.", to be confirmed by the control engineer.
  9. A drill-down for the evidence strip? Peak evidence, Qualified support and Non-overlap windows open nothing. The Window Inspector takes a window end, not a period. Recommended: Non-overlap windows opens the Window Inspector over the episode period (needs from / to on that page). Not drawn.

Found on the way, not part of this proposal

  • Today the "Shelf expired · unreviewed" pill runs into the Opened date (EVT-829). The proposal's column widths fit it.
  • All 26 open fast conditions are stale on the lab (last update 7 Nov or earlier), and nine loops hold two open records of the same condition (TIC30501 since 11 Oct and since 7 Nov). Engine side, not the page.
  • The lab has no Medium episode (Low 55, Medium 0 of 500) and no shelved one (Shelved 0); the shelved state is drawn as illustrative.
  • The Traverse guide gives priority and severity no status colour; High is red today. Not changed here.
  • During capture the lab answered HTTP 500 a few times (the conditions read, EVT-829's actions and notes); the next read worked.
